title: Ahaziah's Mother Athaliah Destroys the Royal Line and Joash is Saved
description: When Athaliah, Ahaziah's mother, learned that her son was dead, she destroyed the entire royal line. But Jehosheba rescued the little Joash and hid him in the house of the Lord for six years while Athaliah reigned. In the seventh year, the priest Jehoiada organized a revolt: he gathered the officers and bodyguards, crowned and anointed Joash as king in the temple, and had Athaliah killed at the Horse Gate when she cried out "Treason!"
